comment.narrative: Habitat for Humanity will seek a no cost extension till December 2023.The project and its operational areas were deeply impacted by the consequences of Covid 19 pandemic and the subsequent lockdowns. These observations were also reflected in the ROM report. Based on the recommendations of ROM report Habitat for Humanity India is working on revising the project timelines and targets to make them more realistic and achievable in the current context. Accordingly a no cost extension proposal is being prepared and will be submitted for approval.
